phpstan:nullCoalesce.variable.explanation: A value may be null here; callers can hit a runtime TypeError or silent skip.

phpstan:property.nonObject.explanation: Property access on a possibly-null object fails at runtime.

phpstan:argument.type.explanation: Argument type does not match the declared parameter; expect TypeError or wrong behaviour.

phpstan:return.type.explanation: Returned value does not match the declared return type.

phpstan:class.notFound.explanation: Referenced class cannot be resolved — missing autoload or undeclared dependency.

phpstan:variable.undefined.explanation: Undefined variable — will raise a notice or Error depending on PHP version.

phpstan:method.notFound.explanation: Call to an undefined method — the object type does not declare this member; expect a fatal error at runtime.

phpstan:staticMethod.notFound.explanation: Call to an undefined static method — class or trait does not expose this API.

phpstan:property.notFound.explanation: Access to an undefined property — the declared type has no such member.

phpstan:class.unused.explanation: Class is declared but never referenced — candidate for removal or missing wiring.

php-test:no-framework.explanation: Project has PHP source but no Pest/PHPUnit markers (composer dev-deps, phpunit.xml, or tests/Pest.php).

php-test:missing-test.explanation: Concrete class has no matching tests/.../{Class}Test.php file under common PHPUnit/Pest conventions.

phpcs:PSR12.Files.FileHeader.SpacingAfte.explanation: PSR-12 file header spacing — declare(), namespace, and use blocks need blank lines between them.

phpcs:Generic.Files.LineLength.TooLong.explanation: Line exceeds the configured maximum length — harder to review and diff.

phpmd:UnusedCode.UnusedPrivateField.explanation: Private field is never read — dead state that can be removed or wired up.

phpmd:Design.LongMethod.explanation: Method is long — harder to test and reason about; consider extracting helpers.

phpmd:CodeSize.ExcessiveMethodLength.explanation: Method exceeds the configured line budget — split or simplify control flow.

phpmd:Naming.ShortVariable.explanation: Very short variable name — prefer a descriptive identifier for maintainability.

eslint:no-unused-vars.explanation: Variable declared but never used — dead code that inflates the module's surface area.

eslint:no-undef.explanation: Reference to an undeclared variable — likely a missing import or a global not listed in env.

eslint:@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-an.explanation: Explicit `any` disables type checking for this expression; prefer a concrete type.

eslint:@typescript-eslint/no-unsafe-assi.explanation: Assigning an `any`-typed value bypasses type safety; the receiving variable is effectively untyped.

eslint:@typescript-eslint/no-unsafe-call.explanation: Calling an `any`-typed value — the call may fail at runtime if the value is not a function.

eslint:import/no-unresolved.explanation: Import target could not be resolved — missing package, wrong path, or missing type declaration.

tsc:TS2304.explanation: Cannot find name — the identifier is not declared in scope; check imports or tsconfig paths.

tsc:TS2307.explanation: Cannot find module — the import path cannot be resolved; may need to install types or fix the path.

tsc:TS2322.explanation: Type mismatch — assigned or returned type is incompatible with the declared type.

tsc:TS2345.explanation: Argument of wrong type — the passed value does not satisfy the parameter's type constraint.

tsc:TS2339.explanation: Property does not exist on this type — the object shape does not include this member.

tsc:TS2540.explanation: Cannot assign to a read-only property — the property is declared readonly.

tsc:TS7006.explanation: Parameter implicitly has `any` type — enable noImplicitAny or add an explicit type annotation.
